rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using full name and zip, confirmed the requested item change, and executed the jigsaw modification on the pending order with a correct refund to the original PayPal method. It also confirmed and updated the user profile address. However, the user’s stated need included checking the address and potentially correcting all order addresses as well as the user address. The agent did not check or update the shipping addresses on the user’s pending orders (#W9583042 and #W4082615), even though both orders showed the incorrect 443 Maple Drive. It neither sought explicit confirmation to update order addresses nor performed those updates, leaving a significant part of the request incomplete. All other actions were in line with policy, with proper authentication and confirmation before writes, and accurate final information regarding the item change and refund.
